get.summary: Read a window of a Call's turns around one turn
get.description: Internal, called by core with the shared secret (ADR 0013) so an Owner or Admin can read an assessed turn in context. The Organization is the `X-Organization-Id` header. Returns the turns from `around - window` to `around + window`, oldest first, clipped at the Call's first and last turn; `window` is at most 20 (default 5). A Call that is not the Organization's, or a turn that does not exist, is `request.not_found`. The text is tenant speech: untrusted data, never logged.

schema.description: The 0-based index of the turn to centre the window on.

parameters.description: The 0-based index of the turn to centre the window on.
parameters.name: around

schema.description: Turns to include on each side of `around` (0 to 20).

parameters.description: Turns to include on each side of `around` (0 to 20).
parameters.name: window

post.summary: Add a Line by buying or porting a number
post.description: Owner and Admin only. A port is `porting` until the carrier completes it. Needs an `Idempotency-Key`, so a retry is safe: the same key with the same request answers 200 with the first Line and buys or ports nothing again, for 24 hours.

schema.description: A client-chosen key. The same key with the same request returns the first Line and does nothing again, for 24 hours; the same key with another request is request.idempotency_key_reused (422); the same key while the first request is still running is request.idempotency_in_progress (409, with Retry-After). Required: without it the request is refused as request.invalid (400), so a retry can never buy twice.

parameters.description: A client-chosen key. The same key with the same request returns the first Line and does nothing again, for 24 hours; the same key with another request is request.idempotency_key_reused (422); the same key while the first request is still running is request.idempotency_in_progress (409, with Retry-After). Required: without it the request is refused as request.invalid (400), so a retry can never buy twice.
parameters.name: idempotency-key
